messages:
sarah_sales: FYI — Railway Labs asks us to 'lock' a specific Llama4o-13B build to EU + APAC, want quantized variant available, and private VPC option. They said it's for an upcoming pilot next quarter.
priya_support: Customer sent requirement doc and model artefact link. Ticket RL-879. They marked as 'sales-blocker'.
maya_product: @sarah_sales thanks. Quick triage questions: 1) exact model hash/version? 2) do they need inference-only private package or full on-prem? 3) cost/SLA expectations?
sarah_sales: version 2026-02-llama4o-13b-repro-v2 (they included model card). Private inference only (no training). They're open to paying for reserved capacity.
maya_product: OK. Proposed scope: "catalog lock" (pin model/version), geo provisioning (EU/APAC), quantization profile + validation, private deployment image + onboarding docs, rollout gating criteria. Recommend P2 with sales-backed uplift. Thoughts?
jon_engineering: Requirements from eng side:
- Validate model ops with our quant pipeline (8-bit + int4 experiments) : ~3 dev-days
- Running perf matrix on EU GPU shapes (A10G / H100) : ~2 dev-days
- Add model manifest entry + compatibility tests (tokenizer, kv cache) : 1 dev-day
- Private package: build docker + infra templates + KMS integration checks : 4 dev-days
alex_infra: Capacity note: if they want reserved capacity in APAC we need quota request from infra team and estimate of qps. Also need to confirm IP/egress routing for private VPC.
rachel_prodops: Rollout plan suggestion:
- create canary route (small % traffic) -> observability checks (latency, error rate, token cost)
- automated fallback to hosted Llama4o-v2 if perf regresses
- define launch criteria: latency < 150ms p95 on short seq, no quality regressions on sample prompts, successful kv/cache tests
maya_product: Prioritization: because sales flagged as blocker and customer is willing to pay for dedicated, I'll queue this as P2 with a requested ETA: "ready for pilot" in 3 weeks. Need engineering ack and estimate to confirm.
sarah_sales: They're targeting a pilot kickoff 2026-06-10. Will cover cost of dedicated reserved 1x H100-equivalent for first month if that helps priority.
jon_engineering: Rough estimate total ~10 dev-days (including infra + perf + tests) + 2 days for validation/qa. If we can reuse existing quant profiles maybe less.
maya_product: Action items:
- @jon_engineering open a catalog-onboard PR with model manifest and compatibility matrix
- @alex_infra start quota request for APAC/EU reserved pool
- @rachel_prodops prepare rollout checklist + eval prompt set
- @priya_support keep customer updated on timelines
I will create intake ticket and scope doc.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: INT-3142 (catalog onboard + geo lock). Linked to RL-879.
priya_support: Noted. I'll add the customer acceptance criteria doc provided by Railway to INT-3142.
sarah_sales: Thanks all — I'll sync with customer tomorrow and feed in any non-functional reqs. Please tag me on any blockers. :thumbsup:
maya_product: I'll aim to have the scoped PR + rough ETA in INT-3142 by end of week. Marking this thread as "triaged — awaiting eng confirmation" :eyes:
jon_engineering: Ack. Will post updates in INT-3142 and ping if we need a breakout meeting.
